title: Hardy spaces and quasiregular mappings: averaged derivatives and the $\mathbb{BMO}$ case
summary: We study the Hardy spaces $\mathcal{H}^p$, $0<p<\infty$ of quasiregular mappings on the unit ball $\mathbb{B}^n$ in ${\mathbb{R}}^n$ under the appropriate growth and multiplicity conditions. Our focus is on the averaged derivatives of maps and their Harnack and quantitative Harnack estimates. The averaged derivatives are employed to study the non-tangential limit functions and non-tangential maximal functions of quasiregular mappings and to characterize $\mathcal{H}^p$ in the case of finite multiplicity of $f$.
